item.title: Kasarkod Blue Flag Eco Beach Guide: Coastal Scenery & Marine Ecology
item.description:
Welcome to the Kasarkod Blue Flag Eco Beach audio guide, presented by Lopez Paradise Homestay in Kasarkoda, Honnavar. Kasarkod Eco Beach is located three point four kilometers from Lopez Paradise Homestay. Honnavar is blessed with untouched coastal and estuarine ecology, where the river meets the sea.

Accommodations & on-site private parking: Lopez Paradise Homestay, Pragati Nagar, Kelginuru, Kasarkoda, Honnavar 581342. Phone: +91 8792466846.

item.title: Sharavathi Kandla Mangrove Boardwalk Nature Guide: Estuarine Ecology & Avian Life
item.description:
Welcome to the Sharavathi Kandla Mangrove Boardwalk audio guide, presented by Lopez Paradise Homestay. The Kandla Mangrove Boardwalk is situated three point four kilometers by car, or two point six kilometers by bicycle, from Lopez Paradise Homestay. This scenic wooden walkway is suspended above tidal roots and estuarine waters. Forest Department entry ticket is twenty rupees per person.

Accommodations & on-site private parking: Lopez Paradise Homestay, Pragati Nagar, Kelginuru, Kasarkoda, Honnavar 581342. Phone: +91 8792466846.

item.title: Sharavathi River Backwaters & Boating Audio Companion: Estuaries & Coastal Heritage
item.description:
Welcome to the Sharavathi River Backwaters audio companion, curated for guests of Lopez Paradise Homestay. The Sharavathi River opens into a magnificent estuary before meeting the Arabian Sea at Honnavar. Local backwater boating is located at Kasarkod boat jetty, just two point one kilometers from the homestay. Regulated tokenized rates are fifteen hundred rupees for one hour and twenty-five hundred rupees for two hours per boat.

Accommodations & on-site private parking: Lopez Paradise Homestay, Pragati Nagar, Kelginuru, Kasarkoda, Honnavar 581342. Phone: +91 8792466846.

item.title: Apsarakonda Waterfalls & Hilltop Viewpoint Audio Guide
item.description:
Welcome to the Apsarakonda Waterfalls audio companion, presented by Lopez Paradise Homestay. Apsarakonda Waterfalls and the coastal clifftop garden offer panoramic views of the Arabian Sea. Located just five point eight kilometers from Lopez Paradise Homestay.

Accommodations & on-site private parking: Lopez Paradise Homestay, Pragati Nagar, Kelginuru, Kasarkoda, Honnavar 581342. Phone: +91 8792466846.
